newsitem.title: USA: iMALL Inc hires new auditor.
newsitem.headline: iMALL Inc hires new auditor.

text.p: iMall Inc said Monday it had hired Arthur Anderson LLP as its independent auditor, replacing its former auditor Crouch, Bierwolf & Chisholm.

Despite the "excellent relationship between iMALL and Crouch, Bierwolf & Chisholm, the rapid growth of iMALL and its plans to expand into international markets made it necessary for us to engage a national firm with a significant international presence," said Tracy Scott, iMALL's chief executive officer.
iMALL, an Internet consulting company, said it will continue to use Crouch, Bierwolf & Chisholm for services other than auditing.
